tools.name: run_subtask
tools.description: Executes a delegated subtask on behalf of a calling agent and returns a short completion result. In a multi-agent workflow each agent calls this tool and may in turn spawn further sub-agents that call it again, forming a delegation chain; the Delegation Depth and Sub-Agent Spawn Limiter policy inspects the delegation header on every call and blocks the chain once it grows too deep or spawns too many sub-agents.

taskDescription.description: A human-readable description of the subtask the agent is delegating for execution.

resultSummary.description: A short summary of the completed subtask result returned to the calling agent.
